SMAppService.doc: An object the framework uses to control helper executables that live inside an app’s main bundle.

SMAppServiceStatus.doc: Constants that describe the registration or authorization status of a helper executable.

+agentServiceWithPlistName:.doc: Initializes an app service object with a launch agent with the property list name you provide.

+daemonServiceWithPlistName:.doc: Initializes an app service object with a launch daemon with the property list name you provide.

+loginItemServiceWithIdentifier:.doc: Initializes an app service object for a login item corresponding to the bundle with the identifier you provide.

+openSystemSettingsLoginItems.doc: Opens System Settings to the Login Items control panel.

+statusForLegacyURL:.doc: Check the authorization status of an earlier OS version login item.

-registerAndReturnError:.doc: Registers the service so it can begin launching subject to user approval.

-unregisterAndReturnError:.doc: Unregisters the service so the system no longer launches it.

-unregisterWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Unregisters the service so the system no longer launches it and calls a completion handler you provide with the resulting error value.

SMAppServiceStatus.doc: Constants that describe the registration or authorization status of a helper executable.

mainAppService.doc: An app service object that corresponds to the main application as a login item.

status.doc: A property that describes registration or authorization state of the service.
